goal: Deepen the Alembic space architecture: a confirmable functional charter and machine-enforced dependency DAG across the five repos, internal layer contracts with direction lints everywhere, deep decoupling under a side-effect-free boundary doctrine (no import-time work, injected disposable effects, managed state lifecycles), audited foundational upgrades with measurements, and per-repo independence plus no-undeclared-effects proof on every public entrypoint family.
nonGoals: No duplication of IC scope (wire types, error registry, tool duality, DCR residue, ./tools retirement, SD-5 phase 2, Dashboard contract gates, Plugin vendor wave) - AD consumes IC outputs.
No capability moves without per-item user confirmation; AD2 produces the decision register only.
No AlembicPlugin edits before CKG completes; Plugin joins charters and gates afterward.
No speculative base-layer rewrites: AD5 executes only the AD0-confirmed audit-grounded list, profile-gated where stated; healthy areas stay untouched and recorded.
No public behavior or API-shape changes (structure/lifecycle only); no version bumps or releases without user direction.

demands.title: AD0 Architecture Fact Freeze And Doctrine Gates
demands.purpose: Re-freeze the architecture census, obtain the four user gates (side-effect doctrine, AD5 upgrade list, independence definition, SD-1 relocation), and draft the five functional charters.
requiredEvidence: Re-frozen census F1-F5: direct singleton call counts (Logger 47, pathGuard 53, locator 47+), module-scope mutable state list, listener-leak sites (SyncCoordinator question re-verified against the CO3 fix), foundational audit confirmation

User gates recorded 2026-06-12 (all four adopted): side-effect doctrine standing rule with blessed-singleton whitelist; AD5 upgrade list as proposed with the AST worker pool profile-gated; independence via existing staging tooling with file: links kept for dev; SD-1 phase 2 evaluation relocated from IC6 into AD2

Doctrine standing-rule artifact written with the blessed-singleton whitelist draft; AD5 measurement plan and AST profile threshold fixed; per-repo isolation-proof commands specified; IC6-to-AD2 relocation pointers verified
Doctrine compliance floor number proposed for intake confirmation
Draft functional charters for the five repos ready for AD2 confirmation

demands.title: AD1 Space Dependency DAG Codification
demands.purpose: One space-architecture artifact plus a machine-readable allowed-edge config consumed by every repo's boundary gate; close the gate holes (Alembic edge assertion, Dashboard zero-dependency check).
requiredEvidence: Space-architecture ledger artifact and machine-readable allowed-edge config (Core <- Agent <- Alembic; Core <- Plugin; Dashboard zero-package-dependency)
Each repo's boundary gate consumes the shared config; new Alembic edge assertion and Dashboard zero-dependency gate wired with demonstrated failures
Toolchain baseline recorded as a space floor with a drift-note rule
Plugin gate adoption recorded as a post-CKG completion package with owner and trigger
All owning repos full checks green

demands.title: AD2 Functional Charters And Interface Confirmation
demands.purpose: Confirm per-repo charters (owns/consumes/must-never), map every cross-repo interface to a charter line, and run the systematic placement pass absorbing the parked registers into a per-item user decision register.
requiredEvidence: Five confirmed charters written against real code and the frozen censuses
Cross-repo interface map: every package facade, HTTP contract, MCP surface, and daemon job mapped to a charter line; unmappable items listed as placement questions

Placement decision register absorbing SD-1 phase 2 (Core sinking), SD-6 (daemon observability), R-1 (evolution/panorama), SD-4 Option-C end state - every move a per-item user decision, none implemented
Charter artifacts stored in the space-architecture ledger location from AD1

demands.title: AD3 Internal Layer Contracts Everywhere
demands.purpose: Replicate Core's written-contract plus blocking-direction-lint pattern to Alembic (16 lib/ areas) and Agent (agent/tools/ai), and add a light Dashboard conventions contract.
requiredEvidence: Alembic layer contract over the 16 lib/ areas plus blocking direction lint with a demonstrated failure
Agent layer contract over agent/tools/ai seams plus direction lint with a demonstrated failure
Dashboard conventions contract (views/api/state, normalizer seam) plus the AD1 zero-dependency gate
Each contract enumerates its blessed exceptions exactly (Core panorama-edge precedent)
All owning repos full checks green

demands.title: AD4 Decoupling, Isolation, And The Side-Effect Doctrine
demands.purpose: Apply the adopted doctrine: container-manage or bless every singleton, retire service-locator route sites, managed lifecycles for module-scope state, eliminate import-time work, mandatory listener disposal, doctrine lints wired.
requiredEvidence: Blessed-singleton list is exhaustive; Logger/pathGuard/ModelRegistry/timerRegistry container-managed or blessed per doctrine with the direct-call census driven to the AD0-agreed floor
Service-locator route sites replaced by constructed injection (frozen count to agreed floor, diff evidence)
Managed lifecycles for SSE sessions, rate-limit buckets (eviction), guard review state, parser caches (policy), DaemonJobRunner fallbacks - each with a lifecycle test
Import-time work eliminated: lazy auth secret with documented restart semantics, construction-time config reads
Listener disposal everywhere with leak tests (SSE off-on-close, per-job deregistration, module-init dispose paths)
Doctrine lint (import-time-effect and bare-singleton patterns) wired per repo with demonstrated failures; compliance census re-measured against the ~30% baseline
No public behavior or API-shape change (regression proof via full checks and coverage ratchets)

demands.title: AD5 Foundational Layer Upgrades
demands.purpose: Execute the AD0-confirmed foundational list with before/after measurements; record healthy areas as deliberate.
requiredEvidence: Prepared-statement LRU factory on hot repository paths with before/after throughput measurements
AST parse profile on a large fixture; worker-thread pool implemented only if the AD0 threshold is crossed, otherwise profile recorded and item closed
Provider-aware embedding concurrency with Agent transport capacity hints, measured
SignalAggregator ring-buffer cap and backpressure diagnostics with an overflow test
Realtime delivery-guarantee contract documented with a conformance test
Healthy-area register (WAL stance, drizzle migrations, HNSW, watcher) recorded as deliberate no-action
All owning repos full checks green; coverage ratchets hold

demands.title: AD6 Independence, Completeness, And Pure-Boundary Proof
demands.purpose: Prove per-repo isolation (build/test/stage), declared-effects coverage on every public entrypoint family, and charter completeness.
requiredEvidence: Per-repo isolation proof: build, test, and staging pack evidence via existing staging tooling
Declared-effects notes plus no-undeclared-effects tests for every public entrypoint family (package facades, HTTP routes, MCP tools, CLI, daemon jobs) on representative calls
Charter completeness check: no orphan capability and no empty charter line
Doctrine compliance census meets the AD0-agreed floor
All repos full checks green

demands.title: AD7 Space Architecture Acceptance And Archive
demands.purpose: Run the space gate matrix, review census deltas, deliver the placement decision register to the user, accept and archive.
requiredEvidence: Space gate matrix green: all repos checks plus DAG gates, direction lints, doctrine lints
Census deltas against AD0: singleton direct-calls, locator sites, listener leaks, compliance percentage, upgrade measurements
AD2 placement decision register delivered to the user as follow-up demand candidates
Controller acceptance from raw evidence; ledger archive; Wakeflow verification pass
